Context: 6. Benefit of Two HRAs

Clarification.With effect from 1-7-2017, additional HRA at old duty station will be granted to all those Central Government civilian employees who have been transferred to North-Eastern Region, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Lakshadweep Islands and Ladakh, prior to 1-7-2017 or after 1-7-2017 and continue to remain posted there after 1-7-2017, as under:-
